owner_request.quote: 正样本里面你有没有什么办法帮我再过滤一遍 选出完美的形态图
owner_request.interpretation: Run one deterministic, strict second-pass over all 10,000 weak-positive source examples, while explicitly identifying the 9,976 positives exposed by the current data.yaml. Produce ranked perfect candidates without changing images, labels, splits, eligibility, models, or production state.

owner_reference_geometry.interpretation: #44 and #42 are the only perfect/good calibration anchors. #48 is visually recognizable but deliberately excluded by both pre-release lateness morphology (the move is already inside its core) and dirty post-core release. Semantic rejects use their exact v3 boxes. Boundary-wrong rows are geometry controls only, never whole-event negative labels. The v7 50 are a broad accepted family, not perfect anchors.

profile.direction_normalization: LONG sign +1; SHORT sign -1; time order is never reversed.
profile.shape_normalization: Per-channel z-normalization is used only for sequence shape distance. Absolute amplitude remains in scalar gates.

hard_gates.calibration_contract: #44 and #42 pass every gate; #48 fails at least one pre-release lateness morphology gate and at least one release gate; each explicit semantic reject fails at least one named gate. Thresholds are frozen before inspecting the 10,000-row output distribution.

sequence_distance.method: segment-preserving weighted lock-step Euclidean plus Sakoe-Chiba constrained multivariate DTW and derivative-DTW
sequence_distance.nearest_prefilter_contract: For pools larger than three, rank every reference by segment-preserving lock-step distance and run constrained DTW/DDTW on the closest three; this is frozen before the 10,000-row distribution is inspected.
sequence_distance.window_fraction_scope: The 0.20 fraction records the isolated aeon full-fixture parity call. Operational segmented comparison uses the frozen radius of two bars independently inside prelude, core, and release; it does not recompute a percentage per segment.
sequence_distance.implementation_check: The local implementation must be numerically parity-checked against aeon in an isolated evaluation environment; aeon is never installed into the training venv.

ranking.perfect_threshold: minimum leave-one-anchor-out quality score of exact #44 and #42; no 0.90 relaxation
ranking.fail_closed: No scalar gate or score threshold may be relaxed to reach a target count.

reference_gates.tier_rule: A scalar hard-pass row that fails any reference gate remains STRICT_PASS and cannot enter PERFECT_CANDIDATE or STRONG_CANDIDATE.

deduplication.choice: Greedy quality-ordered non-maximum suppression: keep a row only when its core end is more than four hours from every already-kept row for the same symbol and direction.
deduplication.diversity_order: Greedy round-robin over direction and time_block after quality-preserving event deduplication.

controls.owner_reference_separation: #44/#42 pass; #48 fails at least one lateness/release gate; each semantic reject fails; boundary-rebox rows are reported before/after and never treated as class negatives.
controls.boundary_shift_null_metrics: Report morphology-only (release and box excluded) and full-filter-without-box separately.
controls.direction_flip_null: On the same frozen 1,000 rows, flip LONG/SHORT only (never reverse time); report morphology-only and full-filter-without-box pass rates separately.
controls.distance_parity: Compare local DTW/DDTW with aeon on a frozen deterministic fixture.

aeon_1_5_parity_fixture.environment: isolated /tmp evaluation venv; aeon==1.5.0; window=0.20; no dependency installed into the repository training environment

controls.economic_metrics: Not applicable: this is a non-directional P0 morphology ranking with no entry, exit, TP/SL, cost, or model score. Paired boundary-shift and owner-reference separation are the corresponding null controls.

output.gallery_pairing: Each shortlisted sample shows the red-box review image beside the exact clean PNG exposed by the training-dataset manifest.
output.shortlist_scope: Only train/val positives exposed by the current data.yaml may enter the shortlist; all 10,000 source positives remain in ranked_manifest for lineage completeness.
